build_rpn_detector: build a Region Proposal Network detector with backbone, neck, and RPN head components
extract_feat_rpn: extract multi-level features from input images using the RPN backbone and neck
train_rpn_forward: train the RPN detector by computing loss components from ground truth bounding boxes
test_rpn_simple: test the RPN detector to generate region proposals without test time augmentation
test_rpn_aug: test the RPN detector with test time augmentation and bounding box mapping
